slot.brief: Diagram of two springs connected to a mass (series/parallel arrangement); ask for the time period of SHM using the equivalent spring constant.

stem: A block of mass m rests on a smooth horizontal surface. Two identical massless springs, each of force constant k, are connected in series between the block and a fixed wall, as shown in the figure. If the block is displaced slightly along the length of the springs and released, the time period of oscillation is

verdicts.working: For two identical springs in series, 1/k_eff = 1/k + 1/k, so k_eff = k/2. Thus T = 2π√(m/k_eff) = 2π√(2m/k).

working:
For two identical springs in series: 1/k_eq = 1/k + 1/k = 2/k, so k_eq = k/2. T = 2 pi sqrt(m/k_eq) = 2 pi sqrt(2m/k).

Independent check: For two identical springs in series, 1/k_eff = 1/k + 1/k, so k_eff = k/2. Thus T = 2π√(m/k_eff) = 2π√(2m/k).
solution:
For two identical springs in series, $[0m\dfrac{1}{k_{\text{eq}}}=\dfrac{1}{k}+\dfrac{1}{k}$, so $k_{\text{eq}}=\dfrac{k}{2}$.
$$T=2\pi\sqrt{\frac{m}{k_{\text{eq}}}}=2\pi\sqrt{\frac{2m}{k}}$$
